mainEntity.name: What is the best age to get braces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orthodontic evaluation is recommended around age 7. However, braces or aligners can be effective for both teens and adults depending on the condition.

mainEntity.name: How often should I visit the dentist?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is recommended to visit your dentist every 6 months for a routine check-up and cleaning to maintain good oral health.
